text:
alex: Quick check — planning a capacity sweep next Tue (Americas peak window). Need owners for: traffic generator, profiling/traces, runtime knob toggles, and a KV warmup plan. Also thinking about a short mirroring canary. Sketch below, please shout if you can take a piece.

alex: Run sketch: 
- 10m warmup (sequential single-user flows)
- 30m ramp to 60% concurrency
- 45m steady at target throughput (70k rps across endpoints)
- 20m spike test (x3 burst)
- 15m cool down + post-run perf snapshot

alex: Smoke gates I want before we start: p95 < 200ms, total error rate < 1%, no OOMs on any runtime node.

maria: I can own the traffic side and scenarios. Will push templates to infra-tests and wire up a job. planning to run headless Locust and a small k6 shim for specific streaming flows. I'll tag infra-tests PR here when ready. :thumbsup:

maria: example locust command i'll use:
```
LOCUST_MODE=headless locust -f tests/locust/scenarios.py --users 2000 --spawn-rate 200 --headless --run-time 1h
```

jordan: I'll take telemetry/trace sampling and dashboard wiring. For the run please set trace sampling to 10% to avoid ingest spikes. I'll create a dedicated dashboard with error budgets, GC pause, and per-shard p99. Link when done.

jordan: also recommend increasing our statsd flush to 2s for the run to get finer granularity.

sam: I can do KV warmup and prefix seeding. Plan: sequentially touch hot prefixes for 15m then a randomized walk for 5m before the ramp. Script snippet: 
```bash
for p in $(seq 0 199); do curl -sS "$KV_HOST/prefix/$p" >/dev/null; done
```

sam: Also will record before/after cold-start counters so we can quantify cache hit delta.

alex: @tia any blocker on infra? I picked Tue 18:00 UTC as a candidate.

tia: Heads up — dedicated cluster maintenance scheduled Wed 00:00 UTC (so Tue 18:00 UTC is fine). One ask: please avoid node drain ops starting within 2h after our run. I'll notify SRE to block drains. :white_check_mark:

tia: Also, for graceful degradation please include a model fallback plan (downgrade to quantized variant) and a routing policy we can flip if latency >250ms for >5m.

maria: will add a toggle in the traffic job to switch to lighter model variant for a quick rollback test.

ops-bot: Run job created: https://ci.redwood.internal/job/capacity-sweep/1789001234 — owner=@maria — scheduled 2026-05-12T18:00:00Z

alex: Perfect. Quick checklist before run: 
- [ ] traffic job in repo (maria)
- [ ] telemetry dashboard (jordan)
- [ ] KV warmup script (sam)
- [ ] runbook + rollback knobs (alex + tia)
- [ ] canary mirror configured (maria)

jordan: I'll add smoke assertions to the dashboard and an alert to slack if p95 > 220ms during the first 10m.

maria: PR for scenarios up in ~2h, will drop the job link.

sam: KV warmup script pushed to infra-tests/warmers — will run a dry-run tomorrow morning and paste logs.

tia: SRE block added for Tue 18:00-22:00 UTC. No planned infra ops.

alex: Awesome. If nobody objects I'll lock the schedule tomorrow EOD and invite on-call to watch. Thanks all. :rocket:
